objects.name: The Tideless Post
objects.vInscr: The sea never reaches it. The sea never reaches anything.

landmarks.name: The Needle of Struck Names
landmarks.inscription: Every name the god was called was cut here, and every name was cut away. The chains came after, when the names began to return.

landmarks.name: She of the Six Gifts
landmarks.inscription: Each hand held out one gift. The faithful broke off the two they could no longer bear to be given.

landmarks.name: The Sword None Drew
landmarks.inscription: No hand great enough to draw it has come back for it. Many lesser hands have tried.

landmarks.name: The Unshod Waymark
landmarks.inscription: Past this stone the road was held too holy for shoes. The shoes are waiting still.
